timing.scope: Whole receiver durations from the same cached input, direct and synchronized. Stage measurements are independent diagnostics and can overlap. Paired savings use identically indexed repeats. Within-category CPU helper-call totals sum only disjoint calls in the same trial. A stage skipped on an empty-candidate trial has no measured duration. Each state is counted once per panel entry, including distinct actual wire states with equal decoded content.

scope: Frozen 80-frame OPV2V exploratory panel with audited, exact packet states. Both paths reuse the frozen trigger trace. Measured replays use the per-state median paired-run receiver wall, with original packet arrivals and local fallback assumed ready. GPU measurements are single-frame and serial. This does not time the physical network, batch throughput, or a complete sender-to-receiver system.
